scripts.text: I sense that you're different than most people...
scripts.translation: 我覺得你和一般人不太一樣...

scripts.text: I've never met anyone as intimidating as you! For some reason, I don't like you. I think you should leave!
scripts.translation: 我還沒見過像你這麼有壓迫感的人！不知怎麼的，我就是看你不順眼。你還是走吧！

scripts.text: You can't change your job if you have any unused skill points from the 1st job. You better go and use those up first.
scripts.translation: 一轉技能點還沒用完，就不能轉職。先把它們用完再來吧。

scripts.text: Oh, stop making that face. Can you really be in that much pain?
scripts.translation: 行了，別擺出那副表情。真有那麼疼嗎？

scripts.text: Wah wah wah, you're hurting, I can see that. Look, I'll restore HP and SP. Happy?
scripts.translation: 哇哇哇，知道了，我看得出你受傷了。行吧，我幫你恢復HP和SP。滿意了？

scripts.text: Is it that hard to stay alive?
Why don't you try harder next time? You can't force yourself too hard to become an Assassin...
scripts.translation: 下次再努力點吧。想當刺客，也不能把自己逼得太狠...

scripts.text: I will become an Assassin no matter what!
scripts.translation: 無論如何，我都要成為刺客！

scripts.text: Oh man, I gotta take a break.
Take a break? Oh alright, have it your way. When you feel like you're ready to become an Assassin, come back.
scripts.translation: 休息？行吧，隨你。等你準備好當刺客了，再回來。

scripts.text: You'll have to walk if you want to get back to town. Oh, and don't forget to save your spawn point, alright?
scripts.translation: 要回城的話，只能自己走回去。哦，記得儲存重生點，知道嗎？

scripts.text: Hey, what happened...? How come you didn't bring the ^006699Necklace of Oblivion^000000? You're supposed to carry that with you, so where is it?
scripts.translation: 喂，怎麼回事...？你怎麼沒帶泯滅之心？不是讓你隨身帶著嗎，東西呢？ ^006699^000000

scripts.text: You get better get that ^006699Necklace of Oblivion^000000 again before the guildmaster finds out! Hurry, and do your best to get it!
scripts.translation: 趁公會會長還沒發現，趕緊把泯滅之心找回來！快去，想辦法找到它！ ^006699^000000

scripts.text: When you finally succeed in getting it, bring it to me! ^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Well well well, you got it. Congratulations! But since it's been clearly scratched, I can't accept it. You'll never become an Assassin!
scripts.translation: 喲喲喲，還真找回來了。恭喜！不過，上面這麼明顯的劃痕，我可不能收。你這輩子都別想當刺客了！

scripts.text: Hahahah~! I'm just joking, don't take it seriously. But I do need to check this necklace with the guildmaster first.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈~！開個玩笑，別當真。不過，我得先找會長核實一下這條項鍊。

scripts.text: Now! Do your best to be a great Assassin! Travel with faith and kill with dignity. Come by anytime and pay us a visit. Once again, congratulations.
scripts.translation: 好了！努力成為出色的刺客吧！懷著信念行走，以尊嚴揮刃。有空隨時來看看我們。再次恭喜你。

scripts.text: I see you're carrying a ^006699Necklace of Oblivion^000000... You want to become an Assassin, don't you? Let me check it...
scripts.translation: 你帶著泯滅之心啊...想當刺客是吧？讓我檢查一下... ^006699^000000

scripts.text: Why you no good BASTARD! THIS IS A FAKE!
How dare you think of trying to trick me with a fake! Are you stupid or what!? I should kill you...
scripts.translation: 竟敢拿假貨來糊弄我！你腦子有病嗎？！我真該宰了你...

scripts.text: I don't think I like the way you're looking at me... Punk.
scripts.translation: 我看你那眼神就不爽...小混混。

scripts.text: Hey Newbie. You should really get out of here as soon as you can. I can't guarantee your safety.
scripts.translation: 喂，新手，趕緊離開這兒。我可不保證你的安全。

scripts.text: What brings a man of the sword to this place? Why don't you try smashing stuff somewhere else, ya lunkhead.
scripts.translation: 拿劍的來這兒幹什麼？去別的地方砸東西吧，蠢貨。

scripts.text: Now what would a magic user be doing here?
scripts.translation: 用魔法的跑這兒來幹什麼？

scripts.text: There's a library in Prontera and Juno where you're welcome, so why don't you make like a magic trick and disappear?
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉和朱諾的圖書館才歡迎你。你就不能變個魔術，從我眼前消失嗎？

scripts.text: There aren't many Bowmen with the gall to even come close to this place. Well, what do you think you're doin' here?!
scripts.translation: 敢靠近這兒的弓箭手可沒幾個。說吧，跑這兒來幹什麼？！

scripts.text: I thought something smelled funny. What's a servant of God doing in this place? You don't belong here.
scripts.translation: 難怪聞著不對勁。上帝的僕人來這裡做什麼？這裡可不是你該來的地方。

scripts.text: We don't like greedy people around these parts. You better sell your stuff somewhere else, Moneybags.
scripts.translation: 我們這兒不歡迎貪財的傢伙。去別的地方賣你的東西吧，財迷。

scripts.text: You look like you don't have a care in the world. Well, I hope you enjoy your rest while you stay here. It's okay, since the Rogue and Assassin Guilds have always gotten along pretty well.
scripts.translation: 看你這副無憂無慮的樣子。行吧，在這兒好好歇著。沒關係，流氓公會和刺客公會一直挺合得來。

scripts.text: We promised that we'd be together forever. ^666666*Sigh...*^000000 I don't even think she remembers that promise anymore. Then again, we were pretty young back then...
scripts.translation: ..我們說好要永遠在一起的。*嘆氣...*我想她早就忘了這個約定吧。不過，那時我們確實還小... ^666666^000000

scripts.text: Wasn't your name, umm, I remember 'cause it sounded funny to me...
scripts.translation: 你的名字是...嗯，我記得，因為那名字聽著挺有趣...

scripts.text: :+:{0}:+:, right? No wait, just {1}. Yeah, how's it goin'?
scripts.translation: :+::+:，對吧？不，等等，是才對。最近怎麼樣？ {0}{1}

scripts.text: Unfortunately, I don't have any requests for you at this time from the guild. Just keep focusing on your training. Till then, see ya.
scripts.translation: 可惜，公會現在沒什麼任務要交給你。繼續專心訓練吧。回頭見。

scripts.text: You can't change your job if you still have unused skill points from First Job. You better use up those skill points first.
scripts.translation: 一轉技能點還沒用完，就不能轉職。先把那些技能點用完。

scripts.text: And a well-experienced Thief since I can't seem to find my wallet. We do need people like you, you know.
scripts.translation: 還是個老練的盜賊，我的錢包都找不到了。我們正需要你這樣的人。

scripts.text: So how about taking the next step and becoming an Assassin?
scripts.translation: 怎麼樣，要不要更進一步，成為刺客？

scripts.text: Yes. I've picked my last pocket.
Maybe later, I need to steal some things first.
scripts.translation: 改天吧，我還得先偷點東西

scripts.text: It's been a while since I've received a guest. I'm sending
scripts.translation: 好久沒接待客人了。我送你去

scripts.text: Requirements? Well, first you need to be a Thief. Second, you need to be at least Thief job level 40.
scripts.translation: 要求？首先，你得是盜賊。其次，盜賊的職業等級至少要達到40級。

scripts.text: And third, you need to pass a test to become an Assassin. You got
scripts.translation: 第三，要通過考驗才能成為刺客。都記住了

scripts.text: all that? If you're sure of your ability as a Thief, you won't have to worry.
scripts.translation: 吧？對自己的盜賊本事有信心，就沒什麼好擔心的。

scripts.text: Huh. You're not qualified to become an Assassin yet. There are requirements you need to meet first, you know.
scripts.translation: 哼，你還沒資格當刺客。得先滿足條件才行。

scripts.text: Well, keep training. You need to be at least job level 40, got it? But if you're above job level 40, that will probably be even better.
scripts.translation: 繼續訓練吧。職業等級至少得達到40級，明白嗎？超過40級當然更好。

scripts.text: Come closer. I prefer to talk to people face to face. It really irritates me if I have to raise my voice, just so you can hear me.
scripts.translation: 靠近點，我喜歡面對面說話。非得扯著嗓子才能讓你聽見，可真讓人火大。站

scripts.text: I feel irritated when somebody talks to me behind my back.
scripts.translation: 在我背後跟我說話，也一樣讓人煩。

scripts.text: It's been a long time since
I've met such a big failure.
Sorry for laughing, but this is hilarious! Hahaha~ So do you want me to give you some hints?
scripts.translation: 對不起，我不該笑，可這實在太好笑了！哈哈哈~要我給你點提示嗎？

scripts.text: I beg you, give me hints.
Don't laugh at me! Now, give me hints!
...Shut up, I don't need your help!
Well well, aren't we honest. You're not even an Assassin yet, but you're killing me, I tell you, killing me!
scripts.translation: ！！！哎呀，還挺坦誠。你還沒當上刺客，就快把我笑死了，真的，笑死了！

scripts.text: Did you hear that Anonymous one?! 'I beg you, give me hints.' Hahahah!
scripts.translation: 無名者，你聽見沒？！“求你了，給我點提示吧。”哈哈哈！

scripts.text: in a pathetic sort of way.
I'm not gonna give you any hints after all. Hee hee hee~
scripts.translation: 主意了！不給你提示了。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text: Huh. You must have a lot of self confidence to be a Thief nowadays.
scripts.translation: 哼，現在當盜賊的，還真有自信。

scripts.text: Yeah yeah, I understand. Everyone messes up from time to time. Sorry for laughing at your mistakes.
scripts.translation: 行行行，我明白。誰都有失手的時候。剛才不該笑你，對不起。

scripts.text: Hmm. I like your attitude. You should keep your pride as a Thief. Sorry for laughing at your mistakes. I think you'll do better next time.
scripts.translation: 嗯，你這態度我喜歡。當盜賊就該有自己的驕傲。剛才笑話你，對不住了。下次你一定能做得更好。

scripts.text: I'm not allowed to give you hints, I can tell you more about being an Assassin...
scripts.translation: 我不能給你提示，不過可以跟你多講講刺客...

scripts.text: Above all else, we value our dignity. We're Assassins, after all and people will need us.
scripts.translation: 我們最看重的，就是尊嚴。畢竟我們是刺客，總有人需要我們。

scripts.text: If people are close to you in some way, they might not understand what I'm saying. We're born to be loners due to our nature.
scripts.translation: 和你親近的人，也許無法理解我說的這些。我們的天性，註定了我們要獨來獨往。

scripts.text: Imagine if a lover or a friend saw the blood on your hands. There's a chance that they might not stay with you.
scripts.translation: 想想看，戀人或朋友看見你雙手沾滿鮮血，會怎麼樣？他們可能就不願再陪在你身邊了。

scripts.text: Sometimes it gets lonely but it's not that bad. At least I can do what I want to do, you know, and do things my way.
scripts.translation: 有時是有點孤獨，但也沒那麼糟。至少我能做自己想做的事，按自己的方式行事。

scripts.text: Well, that's all I can tell you for now. Does being an Assassin
scripts.translation: 我現在能告訴你的，就這些了。聽完是不是覺得，

scripts.text: Right, that's the spirit. Don't ever let anyone else look down
scripts.translation: 對，就是這股勁。別讓任何人看不起你。

scripts.text: I apologize for laughing at you earlier. I want you to remember to keep that sense of pride and dignity as an Assassin.
scripts.translation: 剛才嘲笑你，我道歉。記住，當了刺客，也要守住自己的驕傲和尊嚴。

scripts.text: I want that you respect the blood that may stain your Katar or Dagger.
scripts.translation: ，也要敬重那些可能染上你拳刃或短劍的鮮血。

scripts.text: Yeah, I can trust you now. Let me give you some important tips.
scripts.translation: 嗯，現在我可以信任你了。給你幾條重要的提示吧。

scripts.text: First of all, Grimtooth is ...A skill specifically for the Katar. Therefore, it doesn't require any skills related to Dagger weapons.
scripts.translation: 首先，無影之牙是...拳刃專用的技能。所以，不需要先學任何與短劍有關的技能。

scripts.text: Double attack ...Haven't you tried it? It allows you to attack an enemy twice at a time.
scripts.translation: 二刀連擊...你沒用過嗎？這個技能能讓你一次攻擊敵人兩下。

scripts.text: Red Blood is an elemental stone, Blue Gemstone doesn't have to do the Assassin job at all!
scripts.translation: 火靈礦石是屬性礦石，藍色魔力礦石則跟刺客職業毫無關係！

scripts.text: Have you ever seen Mages hunt Elder willow using the Cold Bolt skill? Water overpowers Fire. Water puts Fire under control, and Wind puts water under control.
scripts.translation: 你見過魔法師用冰箭術打長老樹精嗎？水剋制火。水能制住火，風又能制住水。

scripts.text: As long as you stick close to the shadows, by walls and things like that, Cloaking will hide you from sight perfectly! Unless some bastard uses a certain detecting skill, you know.
scripts.translation: 只要貼著牆壁之類的地方，躲在陰影裡，偽裝就能讓你完全隱去身形！當然，要是哪個混蛋用了探測技能，那就另說了。

scripts.text: 'Sharpened Legbone of Ghoul' possesses the Undead property.
What kind of weapon have you used so far? Damascus? Gladius? Stiletto? Or Main Gauche? What is that you're carrying now?
scripts.translation: 你用過什麼武器？大馬士革短劍？長柄短劍？雙刃短劍？還是笨拙短劍？現在帶著哪一把？

scripts.text: It's possible to get a slotted Katar from Desert Wolf. Well, just keep that in mind. You will need this information someday.
scripts.translation: 沙漠之狼有可能掉落帶孔拳刃。記住這點，以後會派上用場的。

scripts.text: You can gain a slotted Jur from a buddy living in a dark and damp place under the ground. Well, I have no idea why that dude has that weapon... Maybe he needs it to dig a hole?
scripts.translation: 住在陰暗潮溼地下的那個傢伙，會掉落帶孔的卡塔勒拳刃。我也不知道他為什麼會有那把武器...難道是用來挖洞的？

scripts.text: I've always wanted a frog as a pet. But it's impossible!
scripts.translation: ...我一直想養只青蛙當寵物，可惜辦不到！

scripts.text: As far as I know, a Goblin carrying a hammer possesses the Earth property. Keep in mind that Fire overcomes the Earth property.
scripts.translation: 據我所知，拿榔頭的哥布靈是地屬性。記住，火屬性剋制地屬性。

scripts.text: You know elemental weapons? The names of Blacksmiths are engraved on them usually...
scripts.translation: 你知道屬性武器吧？上面通常刻著鍛造它的鐵匠的名字...

scripts.text: Sell an Elder Willow Card to a Mage as soon as you can. They are mad about the card for some reason. Doesn't it increase the INT of a character? Hmmm...
scripts.translation: 有長老樹精卡片就趕緊賣給魔法師。不知為什麼，他們對這張卡片特別著迷。它不是能增加智力嗎？嗯...

scripts.text: For us, Dodge and Attack is more important than defense. Don't ever think about wearing a helm. It's heavy, uncomfortable and will even block your sight.
scripts.translation: 對我們來說，閃避和攻擊比防禦更重要。別想著戴頭盔，那東西又重又不舒服，還擋視線。

scripts.text: 'Increase Dodge' allows you to have +3% flee rate per skill lvl.
scripts.translation: “殘影”每提升一級，就能增加3%的迴避率。

scripts.text: As I have told you repeatedly: Katar class weapons (Jamadhar/Jur/Katar etc) are two-handed!
scripts.translation: 我說過多少次了：拳刃類武器（秘刃 闇嘯、卡塔勒拳刃、拳刃等）是雙手武器！

scripts.text: City of desert... I miss my hometown, Morocc. I haven't been there for a long time. I feel like I became a Thief a few days ago. Time flies so fast...
scripts.translation: 沙漠之城...真想念我的家鄉夢羅克，好久沒回去了。感覺自己彷彿才當上盜賊沒幾天，時間過得真快...

scripts.text: Heh. I remember my Thief quest. I was so damn nervous when I broke into the farm to get Mushrooms...
scripts.translation: 嘿，我還記得那次盜賊轉職任務。潛進農場偷蘑菇時，緊張得要命...

scripts.text: Insects detect hiding/cloaking skills. Their feelers never fail to find targets.
scripts.translation: 昆蟲能識破隱匿和偽裝。它們的觸角總能找到目標。

scripts.text: I've heard that the Baphomet Jr. Card adds +3 points to Agility and +1 point on Critical Attack...
scripts.translation: 聽說小巴風特卡片能增加3點敏捷和1點暴擊...

scripts.text: Yeah, we Assassins specialize in training Agility. We can gain a bonus of 10 Agility points even before mastering job level. The problem is it won't go up anymore after that, you know.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，我們刺客特別注重敏捷訓練。職業等級還沒到頂，就能獲得10點敏捷加成。不過，之後就不會再增加了。

scripts.text: ^666666*Phew*^000000 That's all I can tell you, though that's a lot of hints. I don't doubt that I told you almost everything.
scripts.translation: *呼——*我能說的就這些了，提示已經夠多了。我看，差不多都告訴你了。 ^666666^000000

scripts.text: Well then, go ask to take the test again with 'The Anonymous.'
scripts.translation: 好了，去找“無名者”，再考一次吧。

scripts.text: How can you not understand the concept of dignity? You just showed some to me just now!
scripts.translation: ...*你怎麼會不懂什麼是尊嚴？剛才不是還讓我見識到了嗎！

scripts.text: Oh, I get it. It wasn't pride you were showing, you were just being a jerk!
scripts.translation: 哦，我懂了。剛才那不是驕傲，你只是欠揍！

scripts.text: Oh, you must be an Assassin trainee. You are here to become
scripts.translation: 哦，你就是刺客學員吧。來這兒是想轉

scripts.text: Okay, good. Let's fill out the application form. Please sign your name and include your job level.
scripts.translation: 好，來填申請表。簽上名字，寫明職業等級。

scripts.text: Wait, Job level {0}?! I can see you've been training pretty hard! My bosses will like this~
scripts.translation: 等等，職業等級？！看來你練得挺勤啊！上頭的人一定喜歡~ {0}

scripts.text: Did you finish the form? Alright, go ahead and give it to me. Give me a second and I'll transport you to the Test Hall.
scripts.translation: 填好了？好，交給我吧。稍等，我把你傳送到考試大廳。

scripts.text: What, are you trying to trick me or something? Don't you wanna be an Assassin?
scripts.translation: ..？怎麼，耍我呢？你到底想不想當刺客？

scripts.text: Yes, I want to be an Assassin.
Fill out the application form with your name and job level.
scripts.translation: 填申請表，寫上名字和職業等級。

scripts.text: Ho? Job Level {0}?! You must have been training really hard. The bosses will like that for sure...
scripts.translation: 哦？職業等級？！你一定練得很勤。上頭的人肯定喜歡... {0}

scripts.text: Are you done filling out the form? Alright, give it to me so I can send you to the Test Hall. Good luck~
scripts.translation: 表填好了？好，交給我，我送你去考試大廳。祝你好運~

scripts.text: Not bad. You fulfilled our requirements. Not bad at all. Now are you done filling out the form?
scripts.translation: 不錯，你符合我們的條件。挺不錯。申請表填好了沒有？

scripts.text: Then give me the form so that I can send you to the Test Hall, alright?
scripts.translation: 把表交給我，我送你去考試大廳，好嗎？祝你好

scripts.text: to try to find or see me...
To become undetectable can only be done by the greatest Assassins!
scripts.translation: ！只有最頂尖的刺客，才能做到不被任何人察覺！

scripts.text: Aren't you scared that you can't see me? I could kill you at any time and it would be so easy...
scripts.translation: 看不見我，你不害怕嗎？我隨時都能輕易取你性命...

scripts.text: I think I crapped my pants!
You're all talk. I challenge you!
A river of blood follows my every footstep. I am nameless, for the sting of my blades is all anyone needs to know.
scripts.translation: 我所行之處，血流成河。我沒有名字，世人只需知道我刀刃的鋒芒。

scripts.text: I am here to test your knowledge, as well as your capacity for heartlessness. Those are both necessary to become an Assassin.
scripts.translation: 我負責考驗你的知識，以及你能有多冷酷。想當刺客，這兩樣缺一不可。

scripts.text: answer my questions correctly. Very difficult questions that only an Assassin can answer.
scripts.translation: 須答對我的問題。題目很難，只有刺客才答得出來。

scripts.text: I am not necessarily cruel. Before we proceed, is there anything you wish to know?
scripts.translation: 不一定殘忍。開始前，有什麼想問的嗎？

scripts.text: Although skills can have circumstantial applications, I will tell you about the basic concepts.
scripts.translation: ..？技能的用法因情況而異，我先講講基本概念。

scripts.text: First, ^3355FFKatar Mastery^000000. This skill increases the damage of Katar class weapons. The higher the skill level, the more damage is increased.
scripts.translation: 首先是拳刃修煉。它能提升拳刃類武器的傷害，技能等級越高，提升越多。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFLeft Hand Mastery^000000 and ^3355FFRight Hand Mastery^000000. Assassins can equip different weapons in each hand when using Dagger class weapons.
scripts.translation: 接下來是左手修煉和右手修煉。使用短劍類武器時，刺客可以雙手各持一把不同的武器。 ^3355FF^000000^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: But it is obviously more difficult to handle 2 weapons at a time than using just one. The Left and Right Hand Mastery skills increase the damage when using two Daggers.
scripts.translation: 同時駕馭兩把武器，當然比只用一把難。左手修煉和右手修煉能提升雙持短劍時的傷害。

scripts.text: However, if you don't want to use two Daggers, you won't need this skill. You will see how 'Left Hand Mastery' works as soon as you reach 'Right Hand Mastery' Level 2.
scripts.translation: 不過，不打算雙持短劍，就不需要這些技能。右手修煉達到2級時，你就能瞭解左手修煉的作用。

scripts.text: ^3355FFSonic Blow^000000 allows you to strike an enemy 8 times at once. This skill only works with Katar weapons because of the speed it requires.
scripts.translation: 音速投擲能一口氣對敵人發動8次打擊。因為要求極快的速度，只能使用拳刃施展。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: Of course, the damage is affected by STR and weapon damage. You'll understand how this skill works when you reach Level 4 Katar Mastery.
scripts.translation: 當然，傷害取決於力量和武器攻擊力。拳刃修煉達到4級時，你就能瞭解這個技能的作用。

scripts.text: ^3355FFGrimtooth^000000 allows you to attack enemies while hiding under the ground. As you master it, you'll be able to attack foes from a distance.
scripts.translation: 無影之牙能讓你藏在地下攻擊敵人。熟練掌握後，還能攻擊遠處的敵人。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: Since it's a ranged attack, it can be very useful when you're surrounded by enemies.
scripts.translation: 這是遠端攻擊，被敵人包圍時尤其有用。

scripts.text: Because you're required to perfectly hide yourself to use this skill, you must first learn Level 2 Cloaking before you can learn Grimtooth.
scripts.translation: 施展這個技能必須完全隱藏身形，所以要先學會2級偽裝，才能學習無影之牙。

scripts.text: To learn ^3355FFCloaking^000000, you must learn Level 2 Hiding. Then you will be able to move while hiding if you are close to a wall.
scripts.translation: 學習偽裝，必須先學會2級隱匿。之後，就能貼著牆壁，在隱藏身形的同時移動。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: The ^3355FFEnchant Poison^000000 skill allows you to enchant poison on the weapon you're using. This will temporarily give the weapon the Poison property.
scripts.translation: 塗毒能給你正在使用的武器塗上毒藥，暫時賦予它毒屬性。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: This will also make your attacks poison the enemy by chance. You can also use this skill to enchant the weapons of your party members...
scripts.translation: 這樣，攻擊就有一定機率使敵人中毒。你也可以用這個技能給隊友的武器塗毒...

scripts.text: ^3355FFPoison React^000000 shields the user from attacks with the Poison property, and can be used on other people as well. However, you must learn Level 3 Enchant Poison first.
scripts.translation: 毒性反彈能保護使用者免受毒屬性攻擊，也能對其他人使用。不過，必須先學會3級塗毒。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFVenom Dust^000000 consumes a Red Gemstone to contaminate an area with poison. The duration of contamination increases with the level of this skill.
scripts.translation: 病毒散撥會消耗一塊紅色魔力礦石，使一片區域染上毒素。技能等級越高，毒素持續的時間越長。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: You can learn the Venom Dust skill after you learn Level 5 Enchant Poison.
scripts.translation: 塗毒達到5級後，就能學習病毒散撥。

scripts.text: ^3355FFVenom Splasher^000000 is a skill that, after it is used on a target, will cause it to explode when its HP is less than a certain amount after three seconds.
scripts.translation: 對目標施展毒性感染後，如果3秒後目標的HP低於一定數值，就會引發爆炸。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: When the target explodes, the enemies in the vicinity are also damaged. This is an essential skill for Assassins. It requires Level 5 Poison React and Level 5 Venom Dust.
scripts.translation: 目標爆炸時，附近的敵人也會受到傷害。這是刺客的必備技能，需要先學會5級毒性反彈和5級病毒散撥。

scripts.text: That's all I have to tell you
For Assassins, Agility, or AGI, is the most important stat.
scripts.translation: ..對於刺客來說，敏捷（AGI）是最重要的屬性。

scripts.text: For the sake of assassination, STR is probably the second most important stat. But that is only my recommendation.
scripts.translation: 要進行暗殺，力量（STR）大概是第二重要的屬性。不過，這只是我的建議。

scripts.text: I cannot give you better advice than that in regards to Stats. You should research and see which stats suit you, and decide what kind of Assassin you want to be.
scripts.translation: 關於屬性，我能給你的建議也就這些。你得自己研究哪些屬性適合你，決定要成為怎樣的刺客。

scripts.text: I'll be the judge of that!
Hmpf. It is now time to test your knowledge. You are not allowed to miss more than one question.
scripts.translation: 哼，現在來考考你的知識。最多隻能答錯一題。

scripts.text: In other words, if you want to pass this test, you must give me 9 correct answers out of 10 questions. I won't let you know which answer you got wrong...
scripts.translation: 也就是說，10道題要答對9道，才能通過。我不會告訴你錯了哪道...

scripts.text: Help me, how do I pass?
scripts.translation: 幫幫我，要怎樣才能通過？

scripts.text: Well, that's a damn good question. But you're banished from the Assassin Guild, so it's no concern of mine...
scripts.translation: 問得倒好。不過，你已經被逐出刺客公會了，我可管不著...

scripts.text: Now go, but do not fear. I will be by your side as you learn the outcome of your choice...
scripts.translation: ...去吧，不必害怕。當你見證自己選擇的結果時，我會在你身旁...

scripts.text: Now, we shall test you once more! Keep in mind, you must answer 9 questions out of 10 correctly. Remember I am doing you a favor...
scripts.translation: 好，再考你一次！記住，10道題要答對9道。別忘了，我是在給你機會...

scripts.text: You must answer 9 questions out of 10 correctly. If you miss more than one question, you can never become an Assassin.
scripts.translation: 10道題最多隻能答錯一道。若錯兩題以上，就永遠無法成為刺客。

scripts.text: 1. Choose skill that is not required to learn Grimtooth.
scripts.translation: 1. 學習無影之牙，不需要先學會以下哪項技能？

scripts.text: 2. What property does Enchant Poison possess?
3. How does Level 4 Right Hand Mastery work?

scripts.translation: 恢復因雙持而降低的傷害的80%
恢復因雙持而降低的傷害的90%

scripts.text: 4. What is the item required for using Venom Dust?
scripts.translation: 4. 使用病毒散撥需要什麼物品？

scripts.text: 5. Which skill can you learn when you reach Level 5 Enchant Poison?
scripts.translation: 5. 塗毒達到5級後，可以學習哪項技能？

scripts.text: 6. Among the following skills, which allows you to walk while invisible?
scripts.translation: 6. 以下哪項技能能讓你在隱身時移動？

scripts.text: 7. Choose the condition that is unrelated to Venom Splasher.
scripts.translation: 7. 以下哪項條件與毒性感染無關？

scripts.text: 8. Which monster is weak to a weapon with Vadon card (adds 20% damage on Fire property monster)?
scripts.translation: 8. 哪種魔物怕裝有螃蟹卡片的武器（對火屬性魔物的傷害增加20%）？

scripts.text: It's a passive skill, so SP use is 0.
It's passive skill, so SP use is 10.
10. What is the best elemental Main Gauche weapon for hunting in Izlude dungeon?
scripts.translation: 10. 在依斯魯得島地下城狩獵，使用哪種屬性的笨拙短劍最好？
掉落帶孔的卡塔勒拳刃？

scripts.text: 3. Which class is allowed to craft elemental weapons?
scripts.translation: 3. 哪個職業能鍛造屬性武器？

scripts.text: 4. Choose the weapon which is not in the Katar class.
scripts.translation: 4. 以下哪把武器不屬於拳刃類？

scripts.text: 5. What property do Izlude dungeon monsters posses?
scripts.translation: 5. 依斯魯得島地下城的魔物是什麼屬性？

scripts.text: 7. Choose a monster that Fire property Daggers work the best on.
scripts.translation: 7. 火屬性短劍對以下哪種魔物效果最好？

scripts.text: 8. Choose the non-elemental Katar from the following:
scripts.translation: 8. 以下哪把拳刃沒有屬性？

scripts.text: 1. Choose the correct amount of the maximum dodge rate increase from the 'Increase Dodge' skill when at level 10.
scripts.translation: 1. “殘影”達到10級時，迴避率最多能增加多少？

scripts.text: 2. Choose a monster which detects hiding/cloaking Thieves and Assassins.
scripts.translation: 2. 以下哪種魔物能識破盜賊和刺客的隱匿或偽裝？

scripts.text: 3. Choose a group of weapons that cannot be used by an Assassin at once.
scripts.translation: 3. 以下哪組武器，刺客無法同時使用？
笨拙短劍 + 長柄短劍
雙刃短劍 + 笨拙短劍

scripts.text: 4. Choose the town where Thieves can change their jobs.
scripts.translation: 4. 在哪座城鎮可以轉職為盜賊？

scripts.text: 5. Choose a card that does not affect the AGI stat.
scripts.translation: 5. 以下哪張卡片不會影響敏捷屬性？

scripts.text: 6. Choose the correct specialty of the Assassin class.
scripts.translation: 6. 以下哪項是刺客的特長？

scripts.text: 7. Choose the maximum AGI bonus an Assassin can get at job level 50.
scripts.translation: 7. 刺客在職業等級50級時，最多能獲得多少敏捷加成？

scripts.text: 8. Choose the item that an Assassin cannot equip.
scripts.translation: 8. 以下哪件裝備，刺客無法使用？

scripts.text: 9. Choose the job change item for Thief.
scripts.translation: 9. 以下哪種物品用於盜賊轉職？

scripts.text: 10. Choose a card that would typically benefit an Assassin the least.
scripts.translation: 10. 通常來說，以下哪張卡片對刺客的幫助最小？

scripts.text: However, another test awaits you. When you go inside the next area, you will receive your instructions...
scripts.translation: 不過，還有一場考驗等著你。進入下一個區域後，會有人告訴你該怎麼做...
讓我看看...你的得分是%...你不及格！

scripts.text: How could you expect to be an Assassin with this score? Keep training and come back when you're ready.
scripts.translation: 就這點分數，還想當刺客？繼續訓練，準備好了再回來。

scripts.text: I would ask 'Khai,' the one who processed your application, for advice.
scripts.translation: 不妨去找“凱”請教，他就是替你辦理申請的人。

scripts.text: You may also use this code: ^880000iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000. Somehow, those words are linked to a vast body of otherworldly knowledge...
scripts.translation: 你也可以使用這個程式碼：iro.ragnarokonline.com。不知為何，這串文字連線著浩瀚的異界知識... ^880000^000000

scripts.text: You didn't fail this time! But you're not done just yet. You have another test ahead of you. Once you proceed, you will be informed about your next trial.
scripts.translation: 這次你通過了！不過，還沒結束，前面還有一場考驗。繼續往前走，就會有人告訴你下一項試煉的內容。
讓我看看...你得了分...你不及格！

scripts.text: You're too underqualified. How can you even think about becoming an Assassin?!
scripts.translation: 你差得太遠了。這樣還敢想著當刺客？！

scripts.text: I'm surprised that you were even able to become a Thief. Go away, and come back only when you know what the hell you're doing.
scripts.translation: 真想不到，你居然能當上盜賊。走吧，等你弄明白自己到底在做什麼，再回來。

scripts.text: Hmpf, if you really don't have a clue, I will give you a little advice.
scripts.translation: 哼，要是真一點頭緒都沒有，我就給你個建議。

scripts.text: Go ask 'Khai,' the guy who takes care of your test application, maybe he will help you.
scripts.translation: 去找“凱”問問，就是負責考試申請的那個人，也許他能幫你。

scripts.text: You may also wish to take advantage of the ancient code, ^3355FFiro.ragnarokonline.com^000000. Supposedly, those words are linked to a vast body of otherworldly knowledge...
scripts.translation: 你也可以藉助這個古老的程式碼：iro.ragnarokonline.com。據說，這串文字連線著浩瀚的異界知識... ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: You can't take the next trial without passing the written test first. You better speak to the Anonymous One...
scripts.translation: 先通過筆試，才能參加下一項試煉。去找無名者吧...

scripts.text: To be honest, I want to grant you the job change without any other condition. Too many pathetic people don't even have the basic knowledge to be Assassins...
scripts.translation: 說實話，我真想直接讓你轉職，不再設別的條件。連刺客的基本知識都不懂的人，實在太多了...

scripts.text: We must keep our dignity as Assassins and be truly great! Regrettably, there are too many idiots that don't have any pride.
scripts.translation: 我們必須守住刺客的尊嚴，成為真正出色的刺客！可惜，毫無驕傲可言的蠢貨太多了。

scripts.text: All Assassins must respect the enemies they slay, the blood that they spill, and above all, maintain their sense of dignity!
scripts.translation: 刺客必須敬重自己斬殺的敵人、灑下的鮮血。最重要的，是守住自己的尊嚴！

scripts.text: Alright. This next trial will test your ability to quickly find your target.
scripts.translation: 好了，接下來的試煉，要考驗你迅速找到目標的能力。

scripts.text: If you're going to be an Assassin, we need to determine whether or not you can distinguish friend from foe in an instant.
scripts.translation: 要當刺客，就得讓我們看看，你能不能瞬間分清敵我。

scripts.text: The main goal of this test is to find and kill as many monsters named ^008800Job change target^000000 as possible.
scripts.translation: 這場考驗的主要任務，是儘可能多地找到並擊殺名為轉職目標的魔物。 ^008800^000000

scripts.text: 6 ^008800Job change target^000000 monsters. They're intermingled among similar looking monsters, so you need to be careful...
scripts.translation: 轉職目標魔物。它們混在外形相似的魔物裡，要仔細辨認... ^008800^000000

scripts.text: If you fail, you'll have to restart this test. Go to the room above
scripts.translation: 失敗了，就得重新考試。到我上方的房間去

scripts.text: me to be transported to the Test Hall.
Only one person is allowed to take the test at a time, so if anyone is taking the test, you'll have to wait until that person finishes.
scripts.translation: 每次只能有一個人考試。如果有人正在裡面，就得等那個人考完。

scripts.text: Hmm, if you're exhausted, I'm willing to bring you back. Of course, if you leave, you'll have to take the job test over again. So what do you want to do?
scripts.translation: 嗯，要是累了，我可以送你回去。不過，離開這裡，就得重新參加轉職考試。你打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Quit the job change test for now.
Damn...! You look like you're in a lot of pain. ^666666*Sigh*^000000 Give me a second, let me try to restore your HP and SP...
scripts.translation: 該死...！看你疼得不輕。*嘆氣*稍等，我幫你恢復HP和SP... ^666666^000000

scripts.text: It looks like you're having a tough time. You're either trying too hard, or not trying hard
scripts.translation: 看來你吃了不少苦頭。小子，你不是太拼命，就是還不夠

scripts.text: Quit the test, eh? Well, I guess you don't wanna waste any more of our time.
scripts.translation: ..要退出考試，是吧？也好，看來你不想再浪費我們的時間了。

scripts.text: Oh hey, don't forget to save your respawn point in town.
scripts.translation: 哦，對了，別忘了回城儲存重生點。

scripts.text: Hey, I'm Thomas. I'm in charge of testing your use of the hiding skill. Think you're up to it?
scripts.translation: 嘿，我是托馬斯，負責考驗你的隱匿技能。有把握嗎？

scripts.text: Listen. In this test, you can't kill any monsters. Your goal is to reach 'Barcardi' at the opposite side of this room.
scripts.translation: 聽好，這場考試不能殺任何魔物。你的任務是走到房間另一頭，找到“巴卡迪”。

scripts.text: So basically, get to the other side of this room and meet 'Barcardi' without killing a single monster. Understand?
scripts.translation: 簡單說，就是一隻魔物也不能殺，穿過房間去見“巴卡迪”。明白了嗎？

scripts.text: If you run away, get a nose bleed and pass out or something like that, I'll fail ya'. Enough talk. Let's see what you got.
scripts.translation: 要是逃跑，或是流著鼻血暈過去之類的，就算你不及格。不多說了，讓我看看你的本事。

scripts.text: You may now proceed to our Guildmaster's room. Good luck!!
scripts.translation: 現在可以去會長的房間了。祝你好運！

scripts.text: This place is called the 'Guildmaster's room,' the deepest place in the Assassin guild.
scripts.translation: 。這裡是“會長室”，位於刺客公會最深處。

scripts.text: I'm going to give you a simple test. Please find your way through this maze and come to me. It is this maze that protects our guild from intruders.
scripts.translation: 我要給你一個簡單的考驗。請穿過迷宮，來到我面前。這個迷宮保護著公會，阻擋外人的入侵。

scripts.text: I saw your resume just now. You're well known as a Thief with guts. Rarely do we receive potential Assassins of your stature.
scripts.translation: 我剛看了你的履歷。你是個出了名的膽大盜賊。像你這樣有資質的刺客候選人，我們很少見到。

scripts.text: May I ask you some questions if you don't mind? You don't have to be nervous. Just remember: if you lie, I will kill you.
scripts.translation: 不介意我問幾個問題吧？不用緊張。只要記住：敢說謊，我就殺了你。

scripts.text: First off, what do you think is the priority of an Assassin?
scripts.translation: 首先，你認為刺客最應該重視什麼？

scripts.text: However, for what reason do you wish for more power? To show off? Personal revenge? For what purpose will you use this power?
scripts.translation: 不過，你為什麼想要更強的力量？炫耀？為自己報仇？你打算用這份力量做什麼？

scripts.text: Yes, I understand. All of us hold grudges against someone else eventually.
scripts.translation: .？嗯，我能理解。每個人總會有怨恨別人的時候。

scripts.text: However, keep in mind that we are not allowed to be emotionally attached. Carry out your duties without question. That is our way.
scripts.translation: 不過，記住，我們不能被感情牽絆。不問緣由，執行職責。這就是我們的行事準則。

scripts.text: Financial reasons...? I won't deny that we all need money to live. But being Assassin means living for a higher purpose.
scripts.translation: 為了錢...？我不否認，大家都需要錢來生活。但刺客應該為更高的目標而活。

scripts.text: Good idea. Traveling around the world will allow you to broaden your experiences.
scripts.translation: 好主意。環遊世界能讓你開闊眼界，豐富閱歷。

scripts.text: Most of us tend to avoid gathering into groups though, but I'm sure you already caught that, yes?
scripts.translation: 不過，我們大多不喜歡結伴行動。這點你應該已經看出來了吧？

scripts.text: In a way, being an Assassin is to live life in loneliness...
scripts.translation: 從某種意義上說，身為刺客就是孤獨地活著...

scripts.text: Did other Assassins tell you that...?
Pride is certainly important, but pride is worth nothing if you do not have any ability.
scripts.translation: 驕傲固然重要，但如果沒有實力，驕傲就毫無價值。

scripts.text: Most of the Assassins you've met before me are brethren that have shared many difficult times together.
scripts.translation: 在見我之前，你遇到的那些刺客，大多都是一起經歷過無數艱難歲月的兄弟。

scripts.text: I can understand why their pride and dignity would be so important to them. Now, for what reason do you wish to become an Assassin?
scripts.translation: 我能理解，他們為什麼如此重視驕傲和尊嚴。那麼，你為什麼想成為刺客？

scripts.text: We are lonely. We will always be alone, even amongst each other...
scripts.translation: .我們是孤獨的，即便身處同伴之間，也始終孤身一人...

scripts.text: But, as I told you before, we have comrades. I recommend having at least one comrade to back up you when you're on a mission.
scripts.translation: 不過，正如我說過的，我們也有同伴。執行任務時，我建議至少找一位同伴為你提供支援。

scripts.text: Well, I can't deny it, we do need money to make a living. But don't you think we should pursue something even more important than money?
scripts.translation: 我不否認，我們確實需要錢來維持生計。但你不覺得，還有比錢更值得追求的東西嗎？

scripts.text: Style and appearance is only superficial. It is sad that many people think this way...
scripts.translation: 裝扮和外表都只是表象。可惜，有太多人只看重這些...

scripts.text: Such disgraceful Assassins that have lost their true focus are dealt with in our own manner...
scripts.translation: 那些忘記本分、令我們蒙羞的刺客，我們自會用自己的方式處置...

scripts.text: Assassins don't toy around. We are not into a style or trend, and we never will be.
scripts.translation: .刺客不是鬧著玩的。我們不追逐時尚或潮流，永遠也不會。

scripts.text: I think you have what it takes. Is there a reason you want to be an Assassin?
scripts.translation: .看來你具備成為刺客的素質。你為什麼想當刺客？

scripts.text: Unlike the Thief class, the Assassin job doesn't allow self-indulgence. Tell me the
scripts.translation: 刺客和盜賊不同，不能放縱自己。告訴我，你為什

scripts.text: Learning skills comes naturally with the Assassin job. But don't think of skills as the best value of your training.
scripts.translation: 當了刺客，自然會學到技能。但不要把技能當作訓練最有價值的收穫。

scripts.text: You won't be satisfied in becoming an Assassin if you think this...
scripts.translation: 抱著這種想法，即使成了刺客，也不會讓你滿足...

scripts.text: It's a goal of yours, eh? Well, I guess you've got to have goals...
scripts.translation: 這是你的目標，是嗎？嗯，人總得有個目標...

scripts.text: I once knew a person who had goals. Long ago, I met someone on assignment who wanted to keep from getting killed before becoming a level 54 knight.
scripts.translation: 我也認識過一個有目標的人。很久以前，執行任務時遇見的那個人，希望自己能活到成為54級騎士。

scripts.text: It's to bad I had to kill him before he was level 52... ^666666*Sigh*^000000 Oh well.
scripts.translation: 可惜，還沒到52級，我就不得不殺了他...*嘆氣*唉，算了。 ^666666^000000

scripts.text: I'm a bit worried about you. I hope you realize that once you become an Assassin, there's no turning back...
scripts.translation: 我有點擔心你。希望你明白，一旦成了刺客，就沒有回頭路了...

scripts.text: That is a good way to improve yourself. I've seen many people who know how to be strong physically but not in their mental state.
scripts.translation: ...這確實能讓你變得更好。我見過很多人，只懂得鍛鍊身體，卻不知道如何讓內心變強。

scripts.text: I hope you're not a hypocrite. Spiritual discipline is the best way for you to survive.
scripts.translation: 希望你不是隻說得好聽。磨鍊心志，才是你生存下去的最好辦法。

scripts.text: Sadly, there are some nit-wits who are eager to be Assassins even though they don't know anything...
scripts.translation: 可惜，有些蠢貨什麼都不懂，卻急著當刺客...

scripts.text: They cause problems and bring us disgrace. Their activities often result in horrible situations.
scripts.translation: 他們惹是生非，讓我們蒙羞。他們的所作所為，常常釀成慘劇。

scripts.text: Be careful lest you become one of them once you become an Assassin. The responsibility rests solely on your shoulders...
scripts.translation: 成為刺客後，可別變成他們那樣。你必須自己承擔這份責任...

scripts.text: So if you could become an Assassin right now, what is the first thing you would do?
scripts.translation: 那麼，要是現在就讓你成為刺客，你會先做什麼？

scripts.text: I would go hunt right away.
There are people waiting for me.
Check how I can help as an Assassin.
scripts.translation: 看看身為刺客能幫上什麼忙

scripts.text: I want to explore my Assassin skills.
I will go where I couldn't go as a Thief.
scripts.translation: 去當盜賊時去不了的地方

scripts.text: Being an Assassin never makes you a different person. And don't rely on chance.
scripts.translation: 當了刺客，你也還是原來的你。別心存僥倖。

scripts.text: It is good for one to examine oneself. I can understand that you will be excited by the great change in your ability.
scripts.translation: 瞭解自己是件好事。能力有了這麼大的變化，你會興奮，我能理解。

scripts.text: In the meantime, I hope you won't forget the Assassin mentality.
scripts.translation: 不過，希望你別忘了刺客應有的心態。

scripts.text: Exploring places you've never seen before. But know that being an Assassin never makes you a different person.
scripts.translation: .去探索沒見過的地方。不過，記住，當了刺客，你也還是原來的你。

scripts.text: Take your time and travel wisely.
Appreciate them for caring about you, even when you're alone.
scripts.translation: 了...即便獨處，也要珍惜他們對你的關心。

scripts.text: Comrades for whom you would die for...
As an Assassin, find a job that you can do for them without them knowing..
scripts.translation: 身為刺客，找些能為他們做的事，默默替他們完成吧。

scripts.text: Haha, the needs of the body are sometimes hard to ignore. It's best to accept that part of human nature.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，肉體的需求有時確實難以忽視。不妨接受這也是人性的一部分。

scripts.text: But you must never reveal to her the Assassin side of your life. No matter what it takes.
scripts.translation: 但無論如何，都不能讓她知道你身為刺客的另一面。

scripts.text: But you must never reveal to him the Assassin side of your life, no matter what it takes.
scripts.translation: 但無論如何，都不能讓他知道你身為刺客的另一面。

scripts.text: Love your beloved forever, even if you can't openly express it. Sometimes, life doesn't allow you to find true love more than once.
scripts.translation: 即使無法公開表達，也要永遠愛著你的摯愛。有時候，人生不會再給你遇見真愛的機會。

scripts.text: That's most admirable. Is there anything that you would like to ask me about?
scripts.translation: 很令人欽佩。你有什麼想問我的嗎？

scripts.text: Places where Assassins can level up...
It all depends on your mind. Any place could be the best to level up according to your mind state.
scripts.translation: 這取決於你的心態。心態合適，任何地方都能成為最好的練級場所。

scripts.text: There are many Assassins out there. Look to them as your trainers, and ask for their opinions.
scripts.translation: 外面有許多刺客。把他們當作老師，向他們請教吧。

scripts.text: I hope you will become an excellent Assassin. And when you reach a certain level, you must guide newbies as your trainers have.
scripts.translation: 希望你能成為出色的刺客。等有了一定實力，也要像教導你的人一樣，去指點新人。

scripts.text: Are you planning to become an Assassin in order to make money?
scripts.translation: ..你打算當刺客，就是為了賺錢？

scripts.text: People of that nature are unwelcome. If such is your goal, you may wish to reconsider your job...
scripts.translation: 我們不歡迎這種人。如果你的目標只是賺錢，還是重新考慮一下職業吧...

scripts.text: It was nice to meet you. You reminded me of the good ol' days.
scripts.translation: 很高興見到你。你讓我想起了從前的好時光。

scripts.text: Those involved with the testing of {0}, please gather before me.
scripts.translation: 負責考驗的各位，請到我面前集合。 {0}

scripts.text: I would like to listen to your opinion of {0} for the job change test.
scripts.translation: 我想聽聽你對在轉職考驗中表現的評價。 {0}

scripts.text: Although {0} looks too mellow and gentle, kind of like a pussycat, {1} has the stuff.
scripts.translation: 雖然看起來太溫順，像只小貓，不過確實有本事。 {0}{1}

scripts.text: If it's alright with you, I'd like to get back to my job.
scripts.translation: 如果沒別的事，我就回去工作了。

scripts.text: Well, I don't like the course score. But, somehow the whole test was passed. I'm okay with this person.
scripts.translation: 嗯，成績不太讓我滿意。不過，畢竟通過了所有考驗，我沒意見。

scripts.text: It seems we are all in agreement. Good. I don't have any problem with {0} as well...
scripts.translation: ..看來大家意見一致。很好，我也贊成轉職... {0}

scripts.text: Even though you're driven by personal revenge, I hope it will go away as you train...
scripts.translation: 雖然你現在一心想為自己復仇，但願訓練能逐漸消解這份執念...

scripts.text: Even though your main concern for now is being a rich, I'm sure you'll pursue something even greater...
scripts.translation: 雖然你現在最在意的是發財，但我相信，你會去追求更高的目標...

scripts.text: Eager to travel all around the world, I hope your real identity is found in your journeys...
scripts.translation: 既然渴望周遊世界，希望你能在旅途中找到真正的自己...

scripts.text: You seem to know a lot about Assassins. I don't think frustration from being alone will be difficult for you...
scripts.translation: 看來你很瞭解刺客。想必孤獨的苦悶不會難倒你...

scripts.text: You have an idiocy about money, but I believe that you should be able to overcome it.
scripts.translation: 你對金錢有些痴迷，但我相信你能克服這一點。

scripts.text: Although I do not trust you for now, I will give you a chance...
scripts.translation: 雖然我現在還不完全信任你，但我會給你一個機會...

scripts.text: Even though you're enamored with Assassins superficially, I believe you will realize the real value of the Assassin job sooner or later.
scripts.translation: 雖然你現在迷戀的只是刺客的外表，但我相信，遲早你會明白這個職業真正的價值。

scripts.text: One of the rare people who seeks better skills, I hope you will realize the importance of spiritual discipline sooner or later.
scripts.translation: 像你這樣追求技藝的人並不多。希望你遲早能明白磨鍊心志的重要性。

scripts.text: Sooner or later, you will find a new goal to which you can devote yourself...
scripts.translation: 遲早，你會找到一個值得全身心投入的新目標...

scripts.text: I know some people care only about their physical training, but
scripts.translation: 有些人只顧著鍛鍊身體。不過，我相

scripts.text: I believe you stand out amongst them...
Well, I've said too much. Please choose a weapon as a present.
scripts.translation: 好了，我說得太多了。選一把武器，作為給你的禮物吧。

scripts.text: You can choose a Jur, Katar, Main Gauche, or a Gladius. As a master, I love them all.
scripts.translation: 你可以選卡塔勒拳刃、拳刃、笨拙短劍或長柄短劍。身為大師，這幾把我都很喜歡。

scripts.text: Good choice. There you are. I hope it will serve you well.
scripts.translation: 刃...選得不錯。給你，希望它能助你一臂之力。

scripts.text: I see. You want to use both hands. Here, take your Main Gauche.
scripts.translation: 原來如此，你想雙持武器。來，拿好你的笨拙短劍。

scripts.text: It used to rule over the Assassin weapon market. Please take care of my gladius.
scripts.translation: ..它曾是刺客武器市場上的霸主。好好愛惜我的長柄短劍吧。

scripts.text: Well, I am giving you a token. Please return to the Assassin expert, the Ferocious-Looking Huey, at the entrance.
scripts.translation: 好了，這個信物給你。回入口處找刺客專家——那位凶神惡煞的休伊吧。

scripts.text: Upon receiving this token, Huey will promote you to an Assassin.
scripts.translation: 把信物交給休伊，他就會為你轉職刺客。

scripts.text: You, {0}, have chosen to live as an Assassin. May you learn our ways and be an honorable example to others.
scripts.translation: ，你選擇了以刺客的身份度過一生。願你學會我們的行事之道，成為值得他人敬重的榜樣。 {0}

scripts.text: Okay, all of you may go back to your positions. I will send you to the entrance as well. Let's move...
scripts.translation: 好，各位回到自己的崗位吧。我也會送你去入口。走吧...

scripts.text: You already finished your test. Why don't you go try to get the ^006699Necklace of Oblivion^000000 so you can change your job?
scripts.translation: 你已經通過考驗了。去拿到泯滅之心，就能轉職了。 ^006699^000000

scripts.text: What the hell? You pressed 'Cancel' during the process. Do you want to change your job or what?
scripts.translation: 搞什麼？你中途按了“取消”。到底想不想轉職？

scripts.text: Ok, let's start again. If you don't listen this time, you won't leave this room alive. You got me?
scripts.translation: ...*好，重新來。這次再不聽話，就別想活著離開這個房間。明白了嗎？

scripts.text: Umm? How come your in here?
You already finished your test, go give your ^006699Necklace of Oblivion^000000 to the Ferocious-looking guy so you can change your job!
scripts.translation: 你已經通過考驗了，快把泯滅之心交給那位凶神惡煞的傢伙，完成轉職！ ^006699^000000

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm not in charge of job changes. Go to the Guildmaster, as he has told you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，轉職不歸我負責。照會長說的，去找他吧。

scripts.text: Now, that place is blocked. You might want to check the other side.
You're getting warmer. You're almost there. Just, turn around a little bit.
scripts.translation: 越來越近了，快到了。稍微轉個方向就好。

scripts.text: You're heading for my assistant. Do you still need to talk to him?
scripts.translation: ..你正往我助手那邊走。還要找他說話嗎？

scripts.text: I can feel your steps near me.
scripts.translation: 我能感覺到，你的腳步離我很近了。

scripts.text: Hm? Not bad. You're almost here.
I don't think you're going the right way.
